SELECT SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(h.source,h.company_code,h.orderType,h.orderNumber) AS CHAR),256) AS source_key,CASE WHEN h.source NOT IN ('SAP','D365','SMS') OR h.source IS NULL THEN 'ERP_SOURCE_UNMAPPED' WHEN h.company_code NOT IN ('001','002','003','004') OR h.company_code IS NULL THEN 'DPPMS_COMPANY_CODE_UNMAPPED' WHEN h.orderType NOT IN ('0','1') OR h.orderType IS NULL THEN 'ORDER_TYPE_UNMAPPED' WHEN h.orderNumber IS NULL OR TRIM(h.orderNumber)='' THEN 'BUSINESS_KEY_MISSING' WHEN h.migrationVersion IS NULL THEN 'SOURCE_VERSION_MISSING' WHEN h.payloadVariants>1 THEN 'DUPLICATE_BUSINESS_KEY_CONFLICT' WHEN h.customerCode IS NOT NULL AND h.customerCode<>'' AND (NOT(h.customerCode REGEXP '^[A-Za-z]') OR CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(h.customerCode,2)))>5) THEN 'ERP_CUSTOMER_CODE_FORMAT_INVALID' ELSE NULL END AS issue, CASE h.`source` WHEN 'SAP' THEN 'SAP' WHEN 'D365' THEN 'D365' WHEN 'SMS' THEN 'SMS' END AS `source_system`, h.`company_code` AS `company_code`, h.`orderNumber` AS `order_no`, CONCAT('BASE_P14|ORDER|',h.source,'|',h.company_code,'|',h.orderType,'|',h.orderNumber) AS `source_record_key`, DATE_FORMAT(h.migrationVersion,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f') AS `source_version`, h.`migrationVersion` AS `source_updated_at`, NOW(3) AS `source_sync_time`, NULL AS `custom_info`, h.`orderType` AS `order_type`, h.`salesType` AS `sales_type`, h.`contractNo` AS `contract_no`, h.`orderExecNumber` AS `execution_no`, CASE WHEN h.customerCode IS NULL OR h.customerCode='' THEN h.customerCode WHEN h.customerCode REGEXP '^[A-Za-z]' AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(h.customerCode,2)))<=5 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(h.customerCode,1),LPAD(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(h.customerCode,2)),5,'0')) ELSE NULL END AS `customer_code`, h.`customerName` AS `customer_name`, h.`projectName` AS `source_project_name`, h.`orderComment` AS `order_comment`, h.`orderCreateTime` AS `order_create_time`, h.`customerRequireTime` AS `customer_required_time`, CASE h.`orderType` WHEN '0' THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN '1' THEN 'RETURNED' END AS `source_lifecycle_status`, CASE h.`orderType` WHEN '0' THEN 'ENABLED' WHEN '1' THEN 'DISABLED' END AS `status` FROM ( SELECT r.source,CASE r.compCode WHEN '01' THEN '001' WHEN '02' THEN '002' WHEN '03' THEN '003' WHEN '04' THEN '004' ELSE r.compCode END AS company_code,r.orderType,r.orderNumber, MAX(r.orderCreateTime) AS orderCreateTime, MAX(r.customerRequireTime) AS customerRequireTime, MAX(r.customerCode) AS customerCode, MAX(r.customerName) AS customerName, MAX(r.projectName) AS projectName, MAX(r.orderComment) AS orderComment, MAX(r.salesType) AS salesType, MAX(r.contractNo) AS contractNo, MAX(r.orderExecNumber) AS orderExecNumber, MAX(r.syncTime) AS migrationVersion, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(JSON_ARRAY(r.orderCreateTime,r.customerRequireTime,r.customerCode,r.customerName,r.projectName,r.orderComment,r.salesType,r.contractNo) AS BINARY)) AS payloadVariants, COUNT(*) AS originalRowCount FROM pm_order_data_from_erp r GROUP BY r.source,company_code,r.orderType,r.orderNumber,CAST(r.source AS BINARY),CAST(r.orderType AS BINARY),CAST(r.orderNumber AS BINARY) ) h
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT h.originalSourceIds AS original_source_ids,SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(h.source,h.company_code,h.lineType,h.orderNumber,h.lineNum) AS CHAR),256) AS source_key,CASE WHEN h.source NOT IN ('SAP','D365','SMS') OR h.source IS NULL THEN 'ERP_SOURCE_UNMAPPED' WHEN h.company_code NOT IN ('001','002','003','004') OR h.company_code IS NULL THEN 'DPPMS_COMPANY_CODE_UNMAPPED' WHEN h.lineType NOT IN ('0','1') OR h.lineType IS NULL THEN 'ORDER_TYPE_UNMAPPED' WHEN h.orderNumber IS NULL OR TRIM(h.orderNumber)='' THEN 'BUSINESS_KEY_MISSING' WHEN h.migrationVersion IS NULL THEN 'SOURCE_VERSION_MISSING' WHEN h.payloadVariants>1 THEN 'DUPLICATE_BUSINESS_KEY_CONFLICT' WHEN h.lineNum IS NULL OR TRIM(h.lineNum)='' THEN 'BUSINESS_KEY_MISSING' WHEN h.lineType='0' AND (h.orderQuantity<0 OR h.openQuantity<0 OR h.orderQuantity-h.openQuantity<0) THEN 'ACTIVE_QUANTITY_NEGATIVE' WHEN h.warrantyMonth<0 THEN 'WARRANTY_MONTH_NEGATIVE' ELSE NULL END AS issue, CASE h.`source` WHEN 'SAP' THEN 'SAP' WHEN 'D365' THEN 'D365' WHEN 'SMS' THEN 'SMS' END AS `source_system`, h.`company_code` AS `company_code`, h.`orderNumber` AS `order_no`, CONCAT('BASE_P14|LINE|',h.source,'|',h.company_code,'|',h.lineType,'|',h.orderNumber,'|',h.lineNum) AS `source_record_key`, DATE_FORMAT(h.migrationVersion,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f') AS `source_version`, h.`migrationVersion` AS `source_updated_at`, NOW(3) AS `source_sync_time`, NULL AS `custom_info`, h.`lineType` AS `order_type`, h.`lineType` AS `line_type`, h.`lineNum` AS `line_no`, h.`itemCode` AS `product_code`, h.`itemDesc` AS `product_desc`, h.`bundleCode` AS `bundle_code`, h.`profitCenter` AS `profit_center`, h.`realOrderExecNumber` AS `real_execution_no`, h.`warrantyMonth` AS `warranty_month`, h.`orderQuantity` AS `order_qty`, h.`openQuantity` AS `open_qty`, (h.orderQuantity-h.openQuantity) AS `delivered_qty`, CASE h.`lineType` WHEN '0' THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN '1' THEN 'RETURNED' END AS `source_lifecycle_status`, CASE h.`lineType` WHEN '0' THEN 'ENABLED' WHEN '1' THEN 'DISABLED' END AS `status` FROM ( SELECT r.source,CASE r.compCode WHEN '01' THEN '001' WHEN '02' THEN '002' WHEN '03' THEN '003' WHEN '04' THEN '004' ELSE r.compCode END AS company_code,r.lineType,r.orderNumber,r.lineNum, MAX(r.itemCode) AS itemCode, MAX(r.itemDesc) AS itemDesc, MAX(r.orderQuantity) AS orderQuantity, MAX(r.openQuantity) AS openQuantity, MAX(r.bundleCode) AS bundleCode, MAX(r.warrantyMonth) AS warrantyMonth, MAX(r.profitCenter) AS profitCenter, MAX(r.realOrderExecNumber) AS realOrderExecNumber, MAX(r.syncTime) AS migrationVersion, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(JSON_ARRAY(r.itemCode,r.itemDesc,r.orderQuantity,r.openQuantity,r.bundleCode,r.warrantyMonth,r.profitCenter,r.realOrderExecNumber) AS BINARY)) AS payloadVariants, GROUP_CONCAT(r.id ORDER BY r.id) AS originalSourceIds, COUNT(*) AS originalRowCount FROM pm_order_line_from_erp r GROUP BY r.source,company_code,r.lineType,r.orderNumber,r.lineNum,CAST(r.source AS BINARY),CAST(r.lineType AS BINARY),CAST(r.orderNumber AS BINARY),CAST(r.lineNum AS BINARY) ) h
LIMIT #{limit}
